description: Returns the top overperforming posts in a niche over a recent window (default one week), plus a breakdown of which content types are driving the trend and which creators are represented. Filter by keyword and platform. Great as the first call in a content-research loop: see what's hot, then deep-dive or remix the winners. Cost: 2 credits per call.

categoryId.description: Niche filter: a category id from list_categories (covers its subtree)
